source: Original stereo float32: channel 0, 1.8*sin(1000 Hz); channel 1, -1.35*sin(1500 Hz); 2*rate+1 frames. No extra context; integer origin; formant preservation off.
duration: Exact ceil(sourceFrames*numerator/denominator), independently computed as integers; rate/channels unchanged; all finite PCM and raw bytes preserved.
frequency: Central largest power-of-two window no longer than half the output; Hann FFT; three-bin log-magnitude interpolation; search +/-12% of independently calculated shifted frequency. Calibrate identical estimator on the original source and exact unity output. Target <=5 cents; retain signed errors and original calibration, do not count unresolved observations as passes.
headroom: Record full-output peak and central fitted amplitude. Peak >1 verifies float headroom only; it is not clipping, transient or perceptual qualification.
parentWorkflows: Actual existing parent artifact verifier for each rate at 3/2,+12 semitones, plus 48k at 1/2,-12: independently verified completion, Apply/Undo/Redo, save/reopen, split/crop/seek, callback partition and shared live/export equality.
